_about: One entry per effect. find.py searches id, name, kind, aliases, look, use_for and mood. Paths are relative to the repo root.

effects.name: Light leak glow transition
looks: warm (red and orange sweep from the left, white-hot band at the bottom)
prism (cyan, green and magenta streaks with a white core)
effects.look: A soft coloured glow swells over the end of clip A, peaks on the cut, washes over clip B and is gone 5 frames later.
effects.use_for: energy cut between b-roll shots, hook into the body, beat drops
effects.command: python3 effects/transitions.py leak A.mov --cut <s in A> B.mov --b-in <s in B> --look warm|prism -o out.mp4

effects.name: Roto silhouette step-in transition
effects.look: The subject's outline from the next shot appears over clip A as a flat cream silhouette for 3 frames, then 1 frame in true colour, then the cut. The subject seems to step into the shot.
effects.use_for: b-roll or a graphic into the talking head; works best when B is the subject on camera
effects.command: python3 effects/transitions.py roto A.mov --cut <s in A> B.mov --b-in <s in B> -o out.mp4

effects.name: Blur blink camera transition
effects.look: Zoom blur and a dark vignette build over 3 frames, peak on the cut and fade over 3 frames: a camera blink.
effects.use_for: cinematic cut between two moving shots, scene change, time jump
effects.command: python3 effects/transitions.py blink A.mov --cut <s in A> B.mov --b-in <s in B> -o out.mp4

effects.name: Zoom-out camera move transition
effects.look: Clip A sits zoomed in (1.3x), then rushes out through the cut in about 2 motion-blurred frames and clip B lands wide and settles in 3 frames. Optional word in the gradient glow style rides the move.
effects.use_for: cut from a close shot to a wide shot, question or reaction moments
effects.command: python3 effects/transitions.py zoomout A.mov --cut <s> B.mov --b-in <s> -o out.mp4 [--text "What"]

effects.name: Focus pull camera blur transition
effects.look: A subtle push in, a light softening just before the cut and for 2 frames after it, like a lens briefly losing focus. Quiet, not a heavy blur.
effects.use_for: calm or cinematic cuts, mood changes, b-roll sequences
effects.command: python3 effects/transitions.py focus A.mov --cut <s> B.mov --b-in <s> -o out.mp4

effects.name: White flash subject transition
effects.look: the subject's frozen outline from the next shot appears over clip A as a warm white silhouette and fades into full colour over 5 frames, then the cut. Softer cousin of T02.
effects.use_for: the subject appearing in a place, scene to scene with the same framing
effects.command: python3 effects/transitions.py whiteflash A.mov --cut <s> B.mov --b-in <s> -o out.mp4

effects.name: Punch-in flash transition
effects.look: The end of a shot washes to white from the left over 2 frames, one red-tinted frame hits, then the next shot cuts in tighter (about 1.15x) and holds.
effects.use_for: jump cuts in a talking head, beat hits, moving from a statement to the punchline
effects.command: python3 effects/transitions.py punch A.mov --cut <s> B.mov --b-in <s> -o out.mp4

effects.name: CRT white flash reset
effects.look: A punched-in shot cuts to 4 frames of white with faint CRT scan lines, then comes back at normal framing: a clean way to undo a punch-in.
effects.use_for: podcast and talking-head clips, after a punch-in, between two lines
effects.command: python3 effects/transitions.py crt A.mov --cut <s> B.mov --b-in <s> -o out.mp4

effects.name: Fade-up stacked title
effects.look: White Helvetica words stacked tight and overlapping, each fading toward its bottom, rising in one by one fast then landing slow.
effects.use_for: calm hook title, Apple style statement, chapter title
effects.command: python3 effects/text_fx.py fade "The Fade Text Effect" --bg clip.mov --at <s> --y 0.15 -o out.mp4 [--alpha text.mov]

effects.name: Premium 3D serif title
effects.look: Embossed Apple Garamond italic: first word grey metal, second word orange red, lit from the top left. The demo uses Apple Garamond; without it the effect falls back to Baskerville.
effects.use_for: money or luxury words, two-word titles, product names
effects.command: python3 effects/text_fx.py premium "Premium|Text" --bg clip.mov --at <s> --y 0.12 -o out.mp4 [--alpha text.mov]

effects.name: Glitch flicker title
effects.look: Chrome italic words that flicker on and off while rising with motion blur, stacked and overlapping.
effects.use_for: hype hook, tech or AI words, fast intros
effects.command: python3 effects/text_fx.py glitch "Glitch Text Effect" --bg clip.mov --at <s> --y 0.13 -o out.mp4 [--alpha text.mov]

effects.name: Bounce captions elastic pop
effects.look: One or two white heavy caps words per card (4 to 8 characters), each new card pops in at 80 % size, overshoots to 106 % and settles at 100 % by the third frame.
effects.use_for: talking-head captions for the whole video, energetic delivery
effects.command: python3 effects/bounce_captions.py --bg clip.mov --at <s> --text "your words" -o out.mp4  (or --words words.json with real word times)

effects.name: Gradient glow rising title
effects.look: Helvetica bold words with an orange to purple gradient and a soft glow, rising slowly into place over the whole clip (fast start, slow landing).
effects.use_for: short spoken questions or punchlines, the word that rides T04
effects.command: python3 effects/text_fx.py gradglow "What are you doing" --bg clip.mov --at <s> --y 0.6 -o out.mp4 [--alpha text.mov]

effects.name: Word slide-up title
effects.look: SF Pro words slide up into place one after another (each word starts about halfway through the one before), fading in over 7 frames.
effects.use_for: clean captions or titles, Apple style
effects.command: python3 effects/hook_fx.py wordslide clip.mov --at <s> --dur 3 --text "Your words" --y 0.5 -o out.mp4

effects.name: Bevel shine sweep title
effects.look: Bevelled grey metal italic letters with a highlight that runs across them about every half second, again and again.
effects.use_for: premium product or brand names, reveal words
effects.command: python3 effects/shine_fx.py sweep "SHINE SWEEP" --bg clip.mov --at <s> --dur 1.5 --y 0.12 -o out.mp4

effects.name: Halftone dots resolve title
effects.look: The words start as one row of big white dots that shrink and multiply until the clean text appears.
effects.use_for: tech or reveal titles, intros
effects.command: python3 effects/shine_fx.py halftone "Your words" --bg clip.mov --at <s> --dur 1.8 --y 0.12 -o out.mp4

effects.name: 3D camera fly-through text
effects.look: Lines of text float at different depths, alternating left and right; the camera creeps forward so each line grows, slides off the edge and goes soft as it passes, while the video behind grows slowly.
effects.use_for: hooks with 2 or 3 short phrases, statement openers
effects.command: python3 effects/camera3d_text.py clip.mov --at <s> --dur 3.2 --lines "built in code|no plugins|just Python" -o out.mp4

effects.name: Apple bounce rise
effects.look: A title (gradient with glow) or any image card, tilted 2.6 degrees, rises from low in the frame, overshoots a little, dips and settles, like Apple's product reveals.
effects.use_for: product or feature reveals, screenshots and cards, 'the all new' style titles
effects.command: python3 effects/apple_bounce.py --bg clip.mov --at <s> --dur 2.2 --text "Introducing" -o out.mp4  (or --image card.png)

effects.name: Blur up slide words
effects.look: Each word rises a little from below, out of focus, and sharpens as it fades in; the next word starts about halfway through the one before; a faint softness stays.
effects.use_for: cinematic captions and titles over b-roll
effects.command: python3 effects/hook_fx.py blurslide clip.mov --at <s> --dur 2.4 --text "Your words" --y 0.72 --size 90 -o out.mp4

effects.name: Continuous slide through
effects.look: A word whips in from the left, slows and drifts through the middle without stopping, then eases off to the right.
effects.use_for: passing statements, lists of words, rhythm text
effects.command: python3 effects/hook_fx.py continuous clip.mov --at <s> --dur 2.4 --text "Continuous" --y 0.72 -o out.mp4  |  blur variant: python3 effects/hook_fx.py continuousblur clip.mov --at <s> --dur 3 --text "Slide right through" -o out.mp4
looks: plain: in from the left, no blur (S5jMgyGgFSc)
blur: in from the right with a strong blur that clears, out to the left blurring again (MLLV9xLqC7o)

effects.name: Selection highlight sweep
effects.look: A dark-blue rounded bar sweeps across the line like a text cursor, leaving a pale-blue highlight box behind it; the words inside turn pale blue, with a soft glow.
effects.use_for: emphasising a caption or key phrase, revealing a name or logo
effects.command: python3 effects/caption_fx.py highlight "Cinematic Captions" --bg clip.mov --at <s> --dur 1.4 --y 0.72 -o out.mp4

effects.name: Word drop stop-motion
effects.look: Words fall into place one after another from above, fading in, and the motion steps every second frame like stop motion.
effects.use_for: captions with a handmade feel, client reels
effects.command: python3 effects/caption_fx.py dropstop "Your words" --bg clip.mov --at <s> --dur 2.2 --y 0.72 -o out.mp4

effects.name: Shaky erode rise title
effects.look: Handwritten letters start as thin strokes and thicken in a few choppy steps (held 4 frames each) while each letter jitters slightly up and down, and the line rises into place.
effects.use_for: playful, handmade or vlog-style titles
effects.command: python3 effects/caption_fx.py shakyerode "Custom Title" --bg clip.mov --at <s> --dur 2 --y 0.72 -o out.mp4

effects.name: Box flash invert boxes
effects.look: Rectangles of the picture flip to a photo negative for 5 or 6 frames at a time: the head, a sky corner, a wide band, a 1-frame thin bar, sometimes two boxes at once or the whole frame, with 8-frame gaps.
effects.use_for: fast b-roll montages, hook energy, highlighting a face or object for a beat
effects.command: python3 effects/box_flash.py clip.mov --at <s> --dur 3 -o out.mp4 [--boxes boxes.json] [--mode difference|exclusion]

effects.name: Four by three rounded window
effects.look: The clip plays inside a 4:3 window with small rounded corners (about 3 % of the frame width), centred on black or any colour.
effects.use_for: b-roll or screen clips in a vertical Short, a framed documentary look
effects.command: python3 effects/window_43.py clip.mov --at <s> --dur 3 -o out.mp4 [--focus 0.32] [--radius 0.06] [--bg 0,0,0]

effects.name: Face lock follow stabilize
effects.look: The head stays fixed in the frame while the background moves around it, zoomed in so no black edges show.
effects.use_for: walking or handheld shots of the subject, b-roll montages, pairs well with the box flash
effects.command: python3 effects/face_lock.py clip.mov --at <s> --dur 3 -o out.mp4 [--zoom 1.18]

effects.name: Super slow motion optical flow
effects.look: Footage slowed about 12x with new in-between frames, so it stays smooth.
effects.use_for: b-roll under the voice so viewers can take in the shot; dramatic moments
effects.command: python3 effects/slowmo.py clip.mov --at <s> --src-dur 0.33 --factor 12 -o out.mp4

effects.name: REC recording overlay
effects.look: A small white REC with a red dot, held over the whole video; it flickers on at the start with the same frames as the glitch title.
effects.use_for: vlog or behind-the-scenes feel, montages; pairs well with the box flash
effects.command: python3 effects/rec_overlay.py clip.mov --at <s> --dur 6 -o out.mp4 [--x 0.5 --y 0.5] [--size 70] [--no-flicker]

effects.name: Hook zoom-out intro
effects.look: The first shot starts zoomed in 2.5x and snaps most of the way back in about 4 frames with motion blur, then glides the last bit over 2 seconds.
effects.use_for: the first 2 seconds of every video
effects.command: python3 effects/hook_fx.py hookzoom clip.mov --at <s> --dur 3 -o out.mp4  |  lens variant: python3 effects/hook_fx.py hookzoomlens clip.mov --at <s> --dur 3 -o out.mp4
looks: lens: plus a barrel lens bulge that settles in 8 frames (Lens Distortion 0.24)

effects.name: Text behind subject
effects.look: Big bold italic words sit behind the subject (the subject passes in front of them), with an optional small title on top in front of the subject, last word in lime.
effects.use_for: hook titles, walk-in shots, thumbnails come alive (needs space around the person: in a tight close-up the head hides the title)
effects.command: python3 effects/hook_fx.py behind clip.mov --at <s> --dur 3 --text "Big Title|Behind You" --front "Watch This:" --y 0.42 --size 150 -o out.mp4

effects.name: Stutter push-in
effects.look: One 2-frame slice repeats again and again (a stuck, glitchy moment) while the picture rushes in and then creeps closer.
effects.use_for: a word where the audio glitches, beat hits, emphasis
effects.command: python3 effects/strobe_fx.py stutter clip.mov --at <s> --dur 1.6 -o out.mp4 [--zoom 1.28]

effects.name: Red flash strobe
effects.look: Two shots cut in 2-frame slices, alternating; some slices glow hot, others turn red. Trippy strobe on a beat.
effects.use_for: music drops, intense moments, montage peaks
effects.command: python3 effects/strobe_fx.py redflash A.mov --at <s> B.mov --b-at <s> --dur 2 -o out.mp4

effects.name: Light rays wipe
effects.look: A strong white burst of rays washes over the shot from the bright areas and slowly pulls back over about 2 seconds.
effects.use_for: dramatic openings, reveals, soft transitions
effects.command: python3 effects/shine_fx.py rays "" --bg clip.mov --at <s> --dur 2.4 -o out.mp4

effects.name: Liquid glass pill
effects.look: A small glass ball rises under the words, then stretches into a rounded glass pill around them; the picture bends at its edges and a thin bright rim catches the light.
effects.use_for: UI-style titles, key words, buttons, Apple style intros
effects.command: python3 effects/liquid_glass.py clip.mov --at <s> --dur 2 --text "In Seconds" --y 0.72 -o out.mp4

effects.name: 3D parallax collage pan
effects.look: Cut-out layers (background, a person, objects, text) sit at different depths; the camera trucks sideways and pushes in a little, so near layers slide past fast and far ones slowly, and text slides in from the side.
effects.use_for: documentary or story openers, turning stills and cut-outs into a 3D scene
effects.command: python3 effects/parallax_collage.py --layers layers.json --dur 3 [--truck 1.3] -o out.mp4

effects.name: Aesthetic moving gradient background
effects.look: A slow-drifting background: deep black on one side melting into grainy royal blue, with film grain. Any 3 colours.
effects.use_for: the plate behind titles, cards and screenshots in faceless or aesthetic reels
effects.command: python3 effects/noise_bg.py --dur 4 -o bg.mp4 [--colors "0,0,0;18,45,150;70,110,215"] [--rate 0.06]

effects.name: Screen replacement corner pin
aliases: put a screenshot on a laptop
effects.look: A screenshot or clip is pinned into a laptop, phone or monitor screen in a shot, following its corners, toned a little darker and softer so it sits in the scene.
effects.use_for: showing a website, app or screenshot on a real device in b-roll or a 3D scene
effects.command: python3 effects/corner_pin.py shot.mov --at <s> --dur 2 --content screenshot.png --corners pins.json -o out.mp4

effects.name: Film look grade
effects.look: A 35 mm style grade: gently lifted blacks, soft highlight roll-off, slightly muted olive greens, warm skin, a faint warm glow around bright edges (halation), a half-strength vignette and fine grain.
effects.use_for: making talking heads and b-roll feel cinematic and consistent
effects.command: python3 effects/film_look.py clip.mov --at <s> --dur 3 -o out.mp4 [--strength 1] [--grain 0.035] [--halation 0.18] [--vignette 0.5] [--compare]

effects.name: Chromatic aberration
effects.look: Thin red and cyan fringes along edges that grow toward the corners, like a cheap lens; the centre stays clean.
effects.use_for: a finishing touch on a grade, gritty or music-video looks
effects.command: python3 effects/chromatic.py clip.mov --at <s> --dur 3 -o out.mp4 [--amount 0.006]

effects.name: Vignette blink flicker
effects.look: Dark soft edges flash on for a frame or two at a time, a few times, then the picture is clean again: a subtle blink.
effects.use_for: hook openers and title moments, a premium feel on b-roll
effects.command: python3 effects/strobe_fx.py vigblink clip.mov --at <s> --dur 1 -o out.mp4
